methodology.leaderboard: OVERALL / ALL time / ordered by PNL
methodology.dualOutcomeRule: A trader is excluded if they currently hold more than one outcome in the same conditionId.
methodology.ranking: Supporter count first, then same-side consensus rate, rank-weighted support, and combined current position value.
methodology.activeMarketRule: Only Gamma markets that are active, not closed or archived, and accepting orders are shown.
methodology.usAvailabilityRule: Only markets that match the daily Polymarket US catalog by exact slug or high-confidence title/slug similarity, and are active, not closed, not archived, not hidden, and with a tradable side, are shown.
methodology.distinctMarketRule: Only one recommendation is shown per Polymarket event; the highest-ranked qualifying child market is kept.
methodology.scanUntilRule: After at least 50 clean traders are collected, the scanner continues down the leaderboard until 4 distinct markets are produced or 300 eligible traders have been inspected.
